source.author: verg
source.text: Est locus Italiae medio sub montibus altis, nobilis et fama multis memoratus in oris, Amsancti valles: densis hunc frondibus atrum urguet utrimque latus nemoris, medioque fragosus dat sonitum saxis et torto vertice torrens.
source.text_original: Est locus Italiae medio sub montibus altis, / nobilis et fama multis memoratus in oris, / Amsancti valles: densis hunc frondibus atrum / urguet utrimque latus nemoris, medioque fragosus / dat sonitum saxis et torto vertice torrens.
source.text_english: There is a place in Italy, beneath high mountains, in the middle, famous and much remembered in many lands: the valleys of Amsanctus. On both sides a dark hillside of thick foliage presses around it, and in the midst a torrent, rough with rocks and with a winding head, makes a sound.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: nititur hinc Talaus fratrisque Leodocus urget remo terga sui, quos nobile contulit Argos.
reuse.text_original: nititur hinc Talaus fratrisque Leodocus urget / remo terga sui, quos nobile contulit Argos.
reuse.text_english: From this side Talaus presses on, and Leodocus drives with his oar the backs of his brother’s men, whom noble Argos had brought together.
